summary: This Form 8-K reports the execution of an underwriting agreement for a commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS) issuance. Natixis Commercial Mortgage Securities LLC, as depositor, and underwriters Natixis, WFS, BMO, and BCI agreed to sell publicly offered certificates with an aggregate principal of $377,960,000, expected to close on or about August 25, 2026. The issuing entity will hold 20 fixed-rate mortgage loans secured by 21 multifamily properties. This is a routine securities offering, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, or other event category applies.
